user.title: GAC Connect
user.description: Beta: unofficial, with limited testing. Remote commands act on your vehicle; use at your own risk. Sign in with the mobile number on your GAC account. You'll solve a slide puzzle and enter a code sent by SMS.

data_description.mobile: For Thailand, enter 08… / 09… / 06… or +66…; both formats are accepted.

sms.title: Enter the SMS code
sms.description: Enter the code just sent to your phone.

profile.title: Set up your vehicle
profile.description: Select an equipment profile for {model}. Auto detect learns from vehicle reports without trying commands. Aion UT omits the fridge, steering wheel heat, sunroof and all eight tyre pressure and temperature sensors. Profiles and manual choices can be changed later in the integration options.

data_description.experimental_pinless_unlock: Allow the Doors control to unlock the car. No PIN required. Leave off to use this control for locking only.

profile_custom.title: Choose supported equipment
profile_custom.description: Turn off the fridge if your car has none, then select any other sensors or controls to omit.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Sign in again to reconnect.

progress.captcha: Solve the slide puzzle in the window that opened, then return here.

error.invalid_thai_mobile: Enter a Thai mobile number such as 0812345678 or +66812345678.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach GAC. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Request a new one and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests to GAC just now. Wait a minute and try again.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle is already set up.
abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles were found on this account.

settings.title: GAC Connect options
settings.description: Auto detect learns from usable readings and remembers them across restarts. Unknown features stay hidden unless you choose Always show. A detected state does not prove that remote commands work; command outcomes are listed separately in diagnostics. No commands are sent to test equipment.

data_description.profile: Switch profiles here. Leaving the Aion UT preset clears its preset exclusions; Auto detect then uses reports to identify equipment, including variants.
data_description.enable_entities: Show these entities even without detection evidence. Omit choices and the separate fridge and location settings still take priority. This does not enable door unlocking or prove a command is supported.
data_description.allow_plaintext_push: Off by default. If GAC offers only a plaintext broker, enabling this sends broker credentials without TLS and allows network interception or forged results. Polling continues when disabled.
data_description.enable_fridge: Allow fridge controls when detected. Turn off to remove them, for example on a trim without one. With Auto detect, Always show can reveal controls before usable fridge readings arrive.
data_description.experimental_pinless_unlock: Allow the Doors control to unlock the car. No PIN required. Leave off to use this control for locking only.
data_description.omit_entities: Select sensors and controls your vehicle does not have. Existing entities are disabled while selected and return with the same IDs if you clear them.
data_description.picture: An image URL, or a /local/ path such as /local/my-car.png for a file in your config/www folder. Leave empty for the built-in AION V picture; other models show the entity's initials.

init.title: GAC Connect
init.description: Vehicle settings are saved when you submit them. You can open another panel here, or close this dialog when finished.

equipment.title: Detected equipment
equipment.description:
These explanations describe integration choices, not a complete list of your car’s hardware. Observing a state does not prove both remote command directions work. No test commands are sent. Hardware readings that disappear temporarily remain remembered. Home Assistant’s own disabled-entity settings can still hide an included entity.

{equipment}

charging.title: Charging schedule
charging.description:
{schedule}

Submitting a charging action returns here after the request is accepted, not after the car confirms it. Check Last command for the outcome.

charge_now.title: Allow unrestricted charging
charge_now.description: Submitting allows the car to charge whenever it is plugged in, overriding scheduled mode. This sends a command to the car. It does not guarantee charging starts immediately. Check Last command and the vehicle’s next report for the outcome.

charge_window.title: Send a charging window
charge_window.description: Submitting sends a new charging schedule to the car. Enter times in {timezone}, the library’s configured regional time zone. If this is not your car’s time zone, use the official app instead. Reported times are not copied here because their clock has not been verified. This does not provide a continuous charging pause.

data.until_soc: Stop at the car’s target charge level

data_description.stop: Use 24-hour time, for example 05:00. An earlier stop time runs into the following day. Start and stop must differ.
data_description.days: Leave empty for every day. For an overnight window, select the day charging starts.
data_description.until_soc: Use the car’s existing target instead of the stop time. This integration cannot read or change that target; verify it in the car or official app.

error.conflicting_entity_choices: An entity cannot be in both Always show and Omit. Remove it from one list.
error.invalid_picture: Enter an image URL (https://…) or a path that starts with /, for example /local/my-car.png.
error.invalid_quiet_time: Enter a time from 00:00 to 23:59 in HH:MM format.
error.quiet_pair_required: Set both quiet-hour times, or clear both to disable quiet hours.
error.quiet_times_equal: Start and end must differ. Clear both to disable quiet hours.
error.invalid_charge_window: Enter different start and stop times in HH:MM format (00:00–23:59) and choose valid days.
error.command_failed: The request was not accepted. Check Last command and Polling status before trying again.

abort.vehicle_not_loaded: The vehicle integration is not loaded. Reconnect it before viewing or changing charging settings.
